newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan spokesman says must avoid sudden forex moves.
newsitem.headline: Japan spokesman says must avoid sudden forex moves.

text.p: Japan must take care to avoid sudden strengthening or weakening of the yen as such moves will have a large impact on the economy, Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama was quoted as saying by the Jiji news agency on Tuesday.
"Sudden strengthening or weakening of the yen has a large impact (on the economy) and we must take caution to avoid such situations," Kajiyama told a news conference.
He added that the plunge in the Tokyo stock market reflected uncertainties over corporate earnings, Jiji said.
The Tokyo Nikkei average closed down 549.81 points at 18,896.19 on Tuesday on lingering worries over the economy.
